name: Universal_Public_Healthcare_Assistance_Policy.pdf
description: Operational manual for cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization coverage under Ayushman Bharat.

pagesText.1:
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
NATIONAL HEALTH AUTHORITY
UNIVERSAL HEALTHCARE ASSISTANCE & HOSPITALIZATION POLICY
1. SCHEME COVERAGE
The healthcare scheme provides a defined benefit cover of Rs 5,00,000 (Rupees Five Lakh) per family
per year on a family floater basis.
pagesText.2:
2. BENEFIT PACKAGE & ENTITLEMENT
2.1 Cashless Inpatient Care:
Beneficiaries are entitled to cashless hospitalization at all empanelled public and private hospitals
across the country.
2.2 Pre-existing Diseases:
All pre-existing medical conditions are covered from day one of enrolment without any waiting period.
2.3 Family Size & Age:
There is no cap on family size or age of family members for healthcare benefit entitlement.

name: Higher_Education_Merit_Scholarship_Rules.pdf
description: National Merit Scholarship rules and eligibility for undergraduate and postgraduate university students.

pagesText.1:
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
MINISTRY OF EDUCATION
CENTRAL SECTOR MERIT SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME FOR HIGHER EDUCATION
1. OBJECTIVE
To provide financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day
expenses while pursuing higher studies.
pagesText.2:
2. ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS
2.1 Academic Threshold:
Students must have secured above the 80th percentile or a minimum of 75% marks in the Class 12
Board Examination.
2.2 Age Limit:
The applicant must be below 25 years of age on the date of application submission.
2.3 Income Limit:
Gross annual family income of parents must not exceed Rs 4,50,000 per annum from all sources.
pagesText.3:
3. SCHOLARSHIP AMOUNT & DURATION
3.1 Financial Rate:
The scholarship amount is Rs 12,000 per annum for Undergraduate studies (first 3 years) and Rs
20,000 per annum at Postgraduate level.
3.2 Renewal Condition:
Scholarship is renewed annually subject to maintaining at least 60% marks and 75% attendance in
each academic year.

name: National_Agriculture_Development_Scheme_Guidelines.pdf
description: Official operational guidelines for Comprehensive Agricultural Welfare & Income Support Scheme.

pagesText.1:
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE & FARMERS WELFARE
NATIONAL COMPREHENSIVE AGRICULTURAL WELFARE SCHEME
1. SCHEME OBJECTIVES
The scheme provides direct income support to small and marginal farmer families to supplement their
financial needs in procuring agricultural inputs and domestic obligations. All payments are transferred
directly via Aadhaar-linked DBT.
pagesText.2:
2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA & CONDITIONS
2.1 Age Limits:
Applicants between 18 and 60 years of age at the time of application are eligible for assistance under
the scheme.
2.2 Landholding & Exclusions:
Small and marginal farmer families possessing cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares are eligible.
Institutional landholders and serving government employees paying income tax are strictly excluded.
pagesText.3:
3. FINANCIAL CEILINGS & PAYMENT SCHEDULE
3.1 Income Ceiling:
The combined annual family income of the applicant from all sources must not exceed Rs 2,00,000
(Rupees Two Lakh only).
3.2 Assistance Amount:
Eligible farmer families receive financial benefit of Rs 6,000 per annum, payable in three equal
four-monthly installments of Rs 2,000 each.
